protocol.loss: Uniform-regime equal-patch channel-scaled RMSE; optional .01 supervised density increments
protocol.checkpoint_policy: Fixed epoch 24 for both cases; no production calibration or assessment selection
protocol.public_train_scope: All 228 dates after the frozen 45-day profile prefix, including earlier development assessments
protocol.limitations: Two development-selected hypotheses for one direction. No production holdout or global ten-direction gate is claimed.

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

source_at_start.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source_at_start.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

source_at_end.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source_at_end.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present
